capabilities: Conceal dynamic blocks behind a blur with per-block and per-note reveal buttons
Target notes by folder, path, tag or frontmatter property rules
Select which individual blocks to veil within one note
Re-conceal blocks on open, after a timeout or when the window loses focus
Adjust blur strength, button style and texts, and add custom CSS selectors
disambiguation: It is a visual veil against shoulder-surfing only; the data stays readable in source mode, search, hover previews and exports.
extras: Not in the community directory yet; it must be built by hand and copied into the plugins folder. The README explicitly warns it is not real protection and documents technical limits such as reliance on Obsidian's rendered CSS classes.
motivation: The README says it is meant for dashboards over finance, health or other personal data that you open in public, revealing only what you need.
problem: Dashboards over personal data show sensitive values the moment a note opens, which is a problem when you use Obsidian in public.

relations.evidence: Conceals the dynamic blocks of chosen notes behind a blur and a reveal button: Dataview queries, DataviewJS scripts

summary: Privacy veil that conceals Dataview, DataviewJS, Bases and chart blocks behind a blur with per-block reveal buttons in notes you choose.
